cases.rationale: Hypothetical FY27 total-GAAP EPS: FQ1 guidance achieved, but a $92.16 residual for the next three quarters reflects memory-cycle normalization in pricing, mix, or utilization; 7x is a multiple stress assumption.

Hypothetical FY27 total-GAAP EPS: FQ1 guidance achieved and $117.16 remains over the last three quarters, requiring AI-memory demand and margins to remain elevated; 7x is held as a sensitivity assumption.
Hypothetical FY27 total-GAAP EPS: FQ1 guidance achieved and $142.16 remains over the last three quarters, requiring continued demand/mix strength; 8x is a sensitivity assumption.

asymmetry.qualification: Compares positive bull gain with absolute negative bear loss only; no probabilities or expected return.

assumptions: FY27 dates are explicit analytical assumptions rather than a verified Micron fiscal calendar. GAAP annual EPS scenarios use FY26 reported GAAP diluted EPS of 74.33 as an anchor and FQ1-27 GAAP guidance of $37.84±$1.00. They hold a split-adjusted per-share basis constant and do not add quarterly EPS with potentially differing weighted diluted shares. Bear $130 assumes the guided FQ1 is achieved but the remaining three quarters contribute $92.16 as memory pricing/mix and utilization normalize; base $155 assumes the guided FQ1 and $117.16 residual on sustained AI-memory demand and high margins; bull $180 assumes the guided FQ1 and $142.16 residual from continued demand/mix strength. The P/E assumptions (7x/7x/8x) are sensitivity inputs, not observed multiples, consensus, fair values, or probabilities. Total GAAP EPS may include non-operating/tax effects not reconciled in the inspected MU release.
qualification: All EPS and P/E inputs are analyst assumptions, not observed multiples or consensus. Prices are conditional sensitivities, not forecasts, probabilities or executable quotes. The earnings period differs from the research horizon; assumption and share-basis suitability require review.
